edges.reason: msg.sender flows into the onlyFromFactoryOrModule check that authorizes addModule.
fallback validates modules[methodToModule[msg.sig]] before forwarding the call, so caller identity drives the authorization path.
onlyWalletModule(wallet) requires Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender) before addGuardian mutates state.
setLock stores msg.sender as lockedBy and is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
setLock compares the supplied lock against block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
touchLastActive writes uint64(block.timestamp) into wallet state.
addToSpent records block.timestamp as spentTimestamp, governing quota decay.
addToWhitelist floors the effective time against block.timestamp.
transact delegates the actual external interaction to nonReentrantCall.
addModule forwards execution to addModuleInternal after the authorization check.
addModuleInternal calls Module(_module).activate(), an external callback into arbitrary module code.
nonReentrantCall performs a value-bearing CALL to the target, which may re-enter the wallet.
nonReentrantCall executes DELEGATECALL into the target, which runs in the wallet's storage context.
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the bound module with a raw call.
sendETH transfers ETH to the recipient through a low-level call without state ordering guarantees.
fastCall performs an assembly call to the destination with caller-supplied gas and value.
_guardValue is read and set by the nonReentrant modifier protecting nonReentrantCall.
initOwner writes the initial owner into _owner storage.
setOwner overwrites the wallet _owner value.
setController replaces the controller reference used for authorization.
addModuleInternal sets modules[_module] = true, extending module authorization.
bindMethod writes the method-to-module binding used by the fallback dispatch.
verifyAndUpdate marks the request hash consumed in the hashes mapping.
verifyAndUpdate writes the accepted nonce into the nonces mapping.
addGuardian pushes data into wallets[wallet].guardians.
changeQuota performs toUint128/toUint64 downcasts while writing quota fields.
checkAndAddToSpent verifies the quota then calls addToSpent to accumulate the amount.
addToSpent adds the amount to the existing spent quota and downcasts it.
addToWhitelist writes the effective time into effectiveTimeMap.
transferOwnership stores the new owner as pendingOwner.
claimOwnership moves pendingOwner into the owner state variable.
removeAddressFromSet decrements set.count and swaps positions after addAddressToSet increments them.
reimburseGasFee multiplies gasAmount by gasPrice then triggers the token transfer.
reimburseGasFee charges the computed gas value through checkAndAddToSpent.
_initialOwner is validated against address(0) and assigned to _owner.
newOwner is validated and written into _owner by setOwner.
The target local flows directly into the low-level CALL of nonReentrantCall.
The nonce parameter is validated by isNonceValid and stored.
The amount parameter is added into the spent quota arithmetic.
The derived recipient is the destination of the sendETH low-level call.
The to parameter is the destination of the fastCall assembly call.
_module is validated, whitelisted via moduleRegistry, and registered in modules.
The wallet parameter selects the storage slot mutated by addGuardian.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only supplies the initial owner value consumed by initOwner.
The parameter is fully consumed by setOwner when writing _owner.
The local target address is the direct receiver of the low-level CALL.
The nonce parameter is validated and stored only inside verifyAndUpdate.
The amount parameter feeds the spent quota arithmetic in addToSpent.
The payable recipient local is the direct destination of the ETH transfer call.
The to parameter is the destination of the assembly call in fastCall.
The module parameter is validated and registered by addModuleInternal.
The wallet parameter only selects the guardian storage entry in addGuardian.
